description: DomainLens – Agent-based domain explorer (FR-008). Adds `domainlens discover --agent` mode where an AI agent actively navigates the codebase using tool calls (read_file, list_directory, glob_files, search_text, read_schema, finish) to discover domain concepts by reasoning, instead of regex and heuristics. Replaces code scanning and heuristic inference steps only; schema extraction, docs, and rules skills remain deterministic.

userStories.title: Extend DomainLensConfig with agent explorer fields
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the config schema and `domainlens init` to support agent explorer settings so that users can configure the explorer model and safety limits per project.
acceptanceCriteria: DomainLensConfig in src/types.ts extended with optional fields: explorer_model?: string, agent_max_files?: number, agent_max_context_tokens?: number
`domainlens init` writes agent_max_files: 150 and agent_max_context_tokens: 100000 to the generated config.json (explorer_model omitted from default — it is optional)
domainlens init is idempotent — running twice does not duplicate or overwrite existing values
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented in US-026 on develop branch.

userStories.title: Implement agent tools module (src/agent/tools.ts)
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a tools module that implements the filesystem and schema tools the agent can call, plus their OpenAI function call schemas, so that the agent loop can execute tool calls locally.
acceptanceCriteria: Creates src/agent/tools.ts with 6 tool implementations: list_directory(path), glob_files(pattern), read_file(path, offset?), search_text(query, path?), read_schema(), finish(concepts)
list_directory: lists files and subdirectories under the given path; skips entries matching the ignore list from config; returns relative paths
glob_files: finds files matching a glob pattern within code_paths; skips ignored directories
read_file: reads a file returning up to 500 lines starting from offset (default 0); returns { content, totalLines, hasMore } so the agent knows if pagination is needed
search_text: searches for a text query across files in code_paths using substring match; returns [{ file, line, text }] (max 50 results)
read_schema: reads and returns the content of .domainlens/schemas/latest.json; returns null if file does not exist
finish: accepts { concepts: AgentConcept[] } where AgentConcept = { concept: string, definition: string, signals: { type: string, detail: string }[] }; this tool terminates the session
Exports AGENT_TOOL_SCHEMAS (array of OpenAI-compatible function definitions) and executeAgentTool(name, args, context) where context = { projectPath, config }
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented in US-027 on develop branch.

userStories.title: Implement runAgentExplorer() session loop (src/agent/explorer.ts)
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the core agentic loop that sends context and tools to the LLM via OpenRouter, executes tool calls locally, handles the soft file cap with user confirmation, enforces the context token limit, and returns AgentConcept[] on completion.
acceptanceCriteria: Creates src/agent/explorer.ts exporting runAgentExplorer(schema, existingSkillNames, config, projectPath): Promise<AgentConcept[]>
Uses the OpenAI client (same pattern as src/llm/openrouter.ts) with baseURL https://openrouter.ai/api/v1; model from config.explorer_model falling back to config.llm_model
System prompt (English) instructs the agent to explore code_paths, understand domain concepts, and call finish() when done
Initial user message includes: schema JSON (from schemas/latest.json), list of existing skill names to skip, code_paths and ignore list
Agentic loop: send messages to LLM → receive tool calls → execute via executeAgentTool() → append results → repeat until finish() is called or limits hit
Streams each tool call to console as it happens: '  → list_directory src/services/' and '  → Concept found: "premium_customer" (3 signals)' when finish() is called

Tracks files read count; at agent_max_files boundary: prints summary of concepts found so far, prompts 'Continue reading? [y/N]' (reads from stdin); if N, delivers partial results; if Y, continues same session
Tracks approximate context tokens (sum of message content lengths / 4); at agent_max_context_tokens: finalizes current concept, logs warning, returns partial results
On any API error: logs error, returns whatever AgentConcept[] were accumulated before the error
Returns AgentConcept[] from finish() arguments or partial results collected during the session
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented as US-028 on develop branch.

userStories.title: Wire --agent flag into domainlens discover
userStories.description: As an engineer, I want `domainlens discover --agent` to replace the regex scanner and heuristic inferrer with the agent explorer, while keeping all other pipeline steps intact.
acceptanceCriteria: DiscoverOptions in src/commands/discover.ts extended with agent?: boolean
--agent flag added to the discover CLI command in src/cli.ts

When --agent is set: steps 2 (code scanner), 3 (ORM scanner), and 5 (heuristic inferrer) are skipped; runAgentExplorer() is called after schema extraction, passing the extracted schema and list of existing skill names

AgentConcept[] from runAgentExplorer() is converted to DomainConcept[] compatible with generateDomainSkills(); the agent-provided definition is used directly (source: ai-generated); enrichConcept() is NOT called
generateRulesSkills() still runs deterministically using the extracted schema and any constants detected — it is not affected by --agent
--agent is compatible with --force (existing skills not passed to agent context), --dry-run (exploration runs, no writes), and --embeddings (pipeline runs after skill generation)
Progress output replaces steps 2-3-5 with: '▶ Step 2/4: Agent exploring codebase...' and streams tool calls
Summary line: 'X skills created (agent-discovered, ai-generated), Y skills updated'
If agent_max_files or agent_max_context_tokens are not set in config, defaults to 150 and 100000 respectively
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add db_type config field, URL inference, and mysql2 dependency
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the config schema to support a `db_type` field so that DomainLens knows whether to connect to PostgreSQL or MySQL, with URL-based inference as fallback for backward compatibility.
acceptanceCriteria: DomainLensConfig in src/types.ts extended with db_type?: 'postgres' | 'mysql'
DEFAULT_CONFIG in src/commands/init.ts includes db_type: 'postgres'
`domainlens init` generates config.json with db_type field
URL inference logic: if db_type is undefined, parse the DATABASE_URL protocol — postgresql:// → postgres, mysql:// → mysql — otherwise default to postgres
mysql2@^3.12 added to package.json dependencies
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement MySQL schema scanner and refactor schema dispatch
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a MySQL schema scanner so that DomainLens can extract schema metadata from MySQL databases, and a dispatcher in schema.ts that routes to the correct driver based on db_type.
acceptanceCriteria: Creates src/extractors/schemaMysql.ts exporting extractSchemaMysql(config): Promise<SchemaCache> using mysql2/promise
MySQL queries use information_schema for tables, columns (with COLUMN_COMMENT), PKs, FKs, CHECK/UNIQUE constraints
MySQL indexes extracted via SHOW INDEX FROM or information_schema.STATISTICS
MySQL enums parsed from COLUMN_TYPE where it contains ENUM(...)
MySQL schema field populated via SELECT DATABASE()
Refactors src/extractors/schema.ts as a dispatcher: reads db_type from config (or infers from URL), imports and calls the appropriate scanner
Existing PostgreSQL extraction in schema.ts is extracted to src/extractors/schemaPostgres.ts without behavior changes
Error handling is identical: on connection failure, logs warning and returns null (preserves existing cache)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add integration tests for MySQL schema extraction
userStories.description: As a developer, I want tests that verify MySQL schema extraction works correctly, so that we catch regressions when modifying the MySQL scanner.
acceptanceCriteria: Creates test file for MySQL scanner (e.g. src/extractors/__tests__/schemaMysql.test.ts or similar)
Integration tests use @testcontainers/mysql to spin up a real MySQL container
Tests verify: table list, column extraction (types, nullable, default, comment), primary keys, foreign keys, indexes, CHECK/UNIQUE constraints, enum column detection
Unit tests verify error handling: unreachable database returns null without throwing
Tests are skippable by default (opt-in via flag or env var like RUN_INTEGRATION_TESTS) so CI does not require MySQL
All existing tests still pass
Typecheck passes
